title: Map with byte-string keys 0a and 09 sorts to host order 09, 0a
why: The Soroban host accepts an SCMap only with its keys in ascending host order (discriminant first, then the value: numbers by value, bytes, strings and symbols as byte strings); a map built in another order is refused when it reaches a contract or the host.

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 17.2.0: scvSortedMap orders the keys 0a, 09, not in host order; 17.2.1 sorts them as the host does.
known_divergences.evidence: probe vector 5b (evidence/sdk-matrix), executed on js 17.2.0; xcc conform run --columns 'js@*' --entries 'cap-0046/api-scval-map-sort-order.bytes-keys'

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: scvSortedMap orders the keys 0a, 09. The map-ordering half of the 17.2.1 fix is not on the 16.x line (the 16.3.1 backport covers asset order only).
